name: MCP
description: Your vault's tools for AIs outside the app (Claude Code, Claude desktop and other MCP clients): search, read, render, query, and write notes, logs, timelines, facts and clippings, the vault's way. Over stdio (vau mcp) and HTTP (/api/mcp), for this machine and its owner only.

allowUsers.label: Other tailnet logins
allowUsers.description: tailnet logins besides this machine's owner that may connect over HTTP through Tailscale Serve, like someone@example.com

allowRemote.label: Anyone who reaches the app
allowRemote.description: lets anyone who reaches the app connect over HTTP, not only this machine's owner and the logins above: only on a network you trust
